consent.title: Your Privacy & Consent
consent.subtitle: Please read carefully before continuing
points: Your responses will be recorded and processed securely.
Uploaded medical documents may be processed using OCR and AI.
An AI-assisted clinical summary will be generated as a draft.
This information will be shared only with your assigned doctor.
Your doctor makes all final clinical decisions — the AI assists, not diagnoses.
You may withdraw consent at any time before submission.
